title: Jump Energy Phase Laws and Honest Inference for Discrete Distributional Synthetic Control
banked_reason: terminal:laundering confirmed by independent validity gate: a legal Bernoulli contiguity diagonal makes the requested all-array conditional-minimax cutoff attainment impossible; the strongest sound result only covers pilot-resolvable regimes.

proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the finite-array six-term endpoint-loss decomposition, all three two-sample phase laws, a globally honest rate-optimal confidence ball, an exact Bernoulli honesty penalty, and conditional-cutoff convergence on quantitatively pilot-resolvable regimes. Attempts to upgrade this to the promised all-array feasible sharp calibration collapsed: fixed local Bernoulli experiments are contiguous to collision, while a slowly diverging diagonal is macro-separated, forcing incompatible cutoff limits. The sound subfield-level mathematics remains reusable, but the field-level all-array attainment kernel is false under the unchanged model.
tldr: Within the maintained exact-fit, common-weight stable-span subclass of discrete distributional synthetic control, the treated unit’s no-intervention quantile law is identified, yielding an exact signed endpoint energy, a constrained weight quadratic, the six-term finite-array decomposition, and three \(n_\ell/\sqrt{m_\ell}\) phase laws. The pre-score limit is explicitly indexed by \(w^0=\lim w_\ell\) and \(\Omega=\lim\Omega_\ell\). Uniformly honest simultaneous \(L^2\) balls attain diameter order \(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4}\), and the conditional Gaussian common cutoff is computable. The proved pilot-split theorem gives a total Borel, globally asymptotically uniformly honest, rate-optimal rule using exhaustive support, covariance-rank, and face enumeration, rational interval certification, explicit error budgets, and finite work. Its normalized squared radius attains \(c^*(\eta,\alpha)\) only under the stated bounded-or-well-separated pilot-resolvability dichotomy: bounded cross-cell translations and face offsets remain in the nuisance supremum, while within-cell root-\(m_\ell\) masses are learned. Full all-strata attainment by another raw-sample construction remains open; the present sublinear pilots cannot attain stratum-specific cutoffs on slowly diverging face or cross-cell diagonals because their root-scale uncertainties are \(n_\ell^{1/8}\) and \(m_\ell^{1/8}\). Oracle reduction is claimed only under quantitatively pilot-resolvable separation and interiority with a continuous nondegenerate critical law. The Bernoulli bracket \(1.913<c_B^*\leq1.914\), versus collision oracle \(1.38590382435\), is the certified honesty penalty.
gap: Chen's published DSC identifies counterfactuals by pre-intervention quantile-residual matching, Gunsilius supplies the quantile-span model and discrete goodness-of-fit asymptotics, and Alvarez--Orestes gives direct DSC inference under smooth continuous-cell and donor-dilution conditions. None supplies inference for a post-treatment no-intervention quantile law identified by an exact period-stable span together with the exact atomic-endpoint and local simplex-face experiment, the pulse-sharp generated-weight cross-vector calculation, its three two-sample phases, or a uniformly honest certified common cutoff; no formula-level claim about Gunsilius Proposition~5 is used because its version-of-record equation was inaccessible.
fill: The theorem program combines the exact six-term finite-array squared-error decomposition, a sharp pulse-geometry bound and joint limit for the pre-weight--post-quantile cross vector, finite-array Gram curvature, the normalized compound loss and three phase laws, exact known-weight and point-mass reductions, the Bernoulli honesty penalty, deterministic conditional-cutoff experiment, legal \(J=2\), \(S=2\), \(D=2\) certificate, and DKW fallback around one falsifiable open target: feasible cutoff attainment with exclusion-budgeted conditional regions and a rate-preserving fallback.
